notes: Aggregate bit rate 103.1 Gb/s; per-lane signaling 25.78125 ± 100 ppm GBd. Loss budget 3.5 dB on up to 500 m SMF with KR4 FEC includes 2.5 dB optical coding gain from RS-FEC (528,514); up to 1 dB MPI loss penalty possible. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 5x10^-5 BER; stressed sensitivity per CWDM4 MSA conformance test at TP3 for 5x10^-5 BER. TDP 3 dB per lane does not include MPI penalty. Transmit OMA per lane -4.5 to 2.5 dBm; Launch Power (OMA-TDP) min -5.5 dBm. LOS Assert LOSA min -28 max -13.6 dBm. Power consumption ≤ 3.5 W when stabilized; may exceed during locking. Case operating temperature 15°C to +60°C only.
